name: PianoXhciHost
comment: Path A2 (docs/drivers/usb-host.md §5.4): PianoXhciHost derives from the collection's AppleUSBXHCI, which is the only kext
named as a library on purpose. com.apple.iokit.IOUSBHostFamily is *not* listed, although the class's base lives there:
AppleUSBXHCI's own bundle already depends on the family, so it is loaded either way, and some inherited slots reach a method
that the collection has as a local symbol in both kexts (AppleUSBHostController::getBusNumber, inlined into each). The
collection builder resolves a local symbol only when exactly one library defines it, so naming the family here would make
those slots ambiguous and the link would fail. tooling/k27/xhci-abi.py check-imports proves this list resolves every import
to the address the ABI data records.
